highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 updates to Skia m154 and ships XML documentation with the managed packages.
highlights_body: The release refreshes the bundled renderer, improves generated binding maintenance, and updates HarfBuzzSharp from the same native source used in the package.

breaking.title: UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 is renamed
breaking.body: The misspelled `CCC133` member is now `CCC132`, matching the corrected upstream HarfBuzz name. Update source references to the new member name before upgrading.

breaking.title: GlyphFlags.Defined is removed
breaking.body: The aggregate flag mask is no longer exposed. Code that used `GlyphFlags.Defined` should combine the concrete glyph flags it needs instead.

bullets.detail: Moves the bundled renderer to m154 and incorporates upstream Chrome fixes for buffer uploads and stale Ganesh cache entries after failed flushes.

bullets.lead: XML API documentation now ships with packages
bullets.detail: Managed package consumers receive compiler-generated XML documentation, including Markdown-authored view remarks, alongside the API assemblies.

bullets.lead: HarfBuzz bindings follow the bundled source
bullets.detail: HarfBuzzSharp bindings are generated from the HarfBuzz revision pinned by Skia, keeping ordinary existing APIs synchronized with the native library.
The m154 release disables RAW and DNG image decoding to avoid relying on unsupported decoding paths.

contributor_summaries.azchohfi: Improved the HarfBuzzSharp native build's compiler-warning handling

preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9: Preview 1 opened the 4.154 line with the Skia m154 engine update.
preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.2.26471.11: Preview 2 added the XML documentation packaging and the regenerated HarfBuzzSharp bindings alongside the m154 upstream fixes.
preview_summaries.v4.154.0-rc.1.26479.14: The release candidate prepared the final package and disabled RAW and DNG decoding.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp now generates its bindings from the bundled HarfBuzz source, keeping the managed declarations aligned with version 14.2.1 while correcting its enum surface.
